2897-3518-3605-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy (with an additional activated ability) of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

4186-4279-6772.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-6772.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

1432-2645-3430-6256.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
1432-2645-3430-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-6495-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-6972.notes:
If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

252-4231-5394-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-7297.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2738-4871-5687-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Skittering Precursor, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2921-5777-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
2921-5777-7810.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7728.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Voracious Brood.
When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4986-5147-5463--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.
4986-5147-5463--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

413-3771-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
413-3771-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Animar. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Tatterkite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

338-4659-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4659-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

5147-5170-6094-6132.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3703-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3845-3944-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1402-2644-4068-4763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1402-2644-4068-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1850-4482-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4482-5413.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2034-2820-4679-5295.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

678-1939-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-1939-5670.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
678-1939-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield, and Enduring Renewal triggers.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, if applicable, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

673-813-2103.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Planar Incision.
673-813-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2131-3017-5660.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature or artifact card in your graveyard.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
2131-3017-5660.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning an artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Thran Vigil triggers. Holding priority, activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding an artifact or creature card.
Resolve the Thran Vigil ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3490-4716-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4716-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1698-2427-3260-3540.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-2427-3260-3540.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-2427-3260-3540.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

3729-6023.description:
Cast Ondu Spiritdancer by paying {4}{W}.
When Ondu Spiritdancer enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Secret Arcade, Ondu Spiritdancer triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 2 using the Ondu Spiritdancer token.

930-2034-3781-5860.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

1679-1722-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1679-1722-5231.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Dire Undercurrents' first ability.
Holding priority, Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dire Undercurrents trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

718-803-3809-4508.description:
Activate Kumano by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

4067-4653-5229.notablePrerequisites:
At least five creatures have died this turn.
Lagomos does not have summoning sickness.
4067-4653-5229.description:
Activate Lagomos by tapping it, searching your library for Ulamog and putting it into your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Ulamog, targeting Lagomos.
Ulamog triggers, shuflling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Mind over Matter trigger, untapping Lagomos.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

3259-4653.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4653.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Lagomos triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

687-1242-2034-2086.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Kitchen Finks dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a -1/-1 counter from Cinderhaze Wretch, and both counters from Kitchen Finks.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 3-5 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 6, causing you to mill three cards and returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

1636-1689-1722-3711-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1689-1722-3711-4474.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

404-1521-2105-4412.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1521-2105-4412.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.
